snippet.title: Cataclismo - The Old Kingdom DLC Trailer | Base Building RTS/Siege Defense
snippet.description:
Rebuild the Old Kingdom in Cataclismo with a new strategic mode – conquer and defend multiple citadels, marshal supply lines to fuel your advance, and hold back escalating waves of horrors as the final reckoning stirs!

Cataclismo - The Old Kingdom will release on August 20th on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, and the Microsoft Store!

Wishlist on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4396100/Cataclismo__The_Old_Kingdom
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/cataclismo_the_old_kingdom
EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/p/cataclismo-the-old-kingdom-396233
Microsoft Game Store: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9NZBKQ3DGDR6
